projections.projection_gate: Frozen upper150m integral/core>5cm/s,interior bracketed selected column and resolved primary lower contour;no positive surface/thermal/relative gate. No opposite-context/deep fill.
projections.branch_scope: Partial Java-Bali study context105-114E on four declared longitude cuts. Both fixed90degree east/270degree west components tested every snapshot,not locally rotated current axes or calendar-selected phases. Upper150m is a source-informed analysis classification,not measured current thickness or a150m bottom.
projections.interpolation_assumption: Keep all four fixed-longitude section references in declared increasing-longitude order;that order is not necessarily downstream for either direction. Selected nodes use derived context profile positions;unselected nodes use original native longitude/latitude-gate midpoint only as an explicit depthless placeholder. Frozen shortestWGS84legs/linear interpolation connect adjacent supported nodes within each direction/date only;never skip gaps,extrapolate,borrow opposite/deeper values or substitute sensitivity cutoffs. Connector distance is not measured current length.
